The '''Jedi Enclave''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi academy|facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]] established prior to the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] funded the [[Jedi Enclaves|enclave]] because of the many [[The Force/Legends|Force]][[Force-sensitive/Legends|-sensitive]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] coming from the planet. While the Kel Dor [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] taught exceptional [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]], Dorin's isolation and [[Dorin gas/Legends|unique atmosphere]] made it nearly impossible for any offworld species to study regularly at the enclave. However, many Jedi visited the facility to study under the masters with the use of [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]]. Following the Jedi Civil War, most of the Jedi at the enclave were killed by [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]].<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
